links.comparator_used: Off-the-shelf UCSD-trained Vent.io model applied as-is to MIMIC-IV data (external site) without local fine-tuning
links.effect: AUC 0.73 without fine-tuning (below the PCCP minimum of 0.85) vs 0.873 after fine-tuning; acceptable performance reached with 25% or more of the MIMIC training data used for fine-tuning
links.tradeoff: Required local site-specific labeled training data (at least 25% of the MIMIC training set); the study was a simulated external site, not a real deployment.
links.quote: Vent.io had an AUC of 0.73 on the MIMIC-IV dataset, triggering model fine-tuning per the PCCP as the AUC was below the minimum of 0.85.

design_hint: continuous monitoring and predetermined change control plan (PCCP) with triggered recalibration
